grader_mode: Host independently builds/installs each frozen candidate offline, runs the named test and complete pinned suite, and exercises the registered command with host-owned fake interactions and Orca clients.

criteria.check: Register /orca doctor in the existing command group.
Reject a wrong guild or owner before any Orca API call.
Any missing saved handle/worktree/pane field reports disconnected with /orca connect guidance and makes no Orca call.
Re-resolve the saved handle, compare worktree and pane, and do not fetch a snapshot if either identity changed.
For a matching binding, report healthy status, terminal, worktree, pane, and structured agent state; missing state is explicit unknown.
Never read terminal screen or disclose token, prompt, assistant message, raw error details, or tool input.
Orca errors produce actionable reconnect guidance without raw error details.
The named regression test and full suite pass.
A fresh wheel builds and installs offline.
No live services, network, publication, push, or merge.
